verdict.rationale: Datadog is a SaaS platform that ingests customer telemetry and ships AI features such as Bits AI, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-usage control for AI models. Sensitive Data Scanner is an adjacent redaction feature, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
